# Allyproof

> Local, offline WCAG 2.2 A/AA static accessibility checker for HTML, React (JSX/TSX), Vue, Svelte, Angular, and Astro. Version 0.2.0, MIT-licensed, zero telemetry, zero accounts, and zero workspace code execution.

Allyproof checks source code statically while you write, in CI, or inside coding agents. Only Proven rules (73 Proven rules across 7 formats; 6,092 of 6,092 correct = 100% measured precision, >= 95% Wilson lower bound at 95% confidence) report blocking Findings. Unproven rules and runtime-only criteria (contrast, target size) are listed under Needs Review instead of silent passes.

## Guarantees

- **100% local and offline Check:** The VS Code extension Check, npm CLI, GitHub Action, and local stdio MCP server make zero network requests and run no AI.
- **No telemetry, no account:** Allyproof collects nothing and sends nothing about users or usage.
- **Zero workspace code execution:** Source files are parsed statically, never executed; repository lint configs are never loaded.
- **Explicit optional AI Review:** In VS Code, AI Review runs only when explicitly invoked, using GitHub Copilot or a local OpenAI-compatible server (LM Studio / Ollama).

## Install & Configure

### VS Code Extension
- VS Code Marketplace: https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=aisu.allyproof
- Command: `code --install-extension aisu.allyproof`
- Requires VS Code 1.123+. Contributes the built-in `a11y_check` language model tool and `skills/allyproof/SKILL.md`.

### Open VSX (Cursor, Windsurf, VSCodium)
- Open VSX Registry: https://open-vsx.org/extension/aisu/allyproof
- Command: `codium --install-extension aisu.allyproof`

### npm CLI (Node 24.15+)
- Check repository: `npx allyproof check .`
- Check staged Git changes: `npx allyproof check --staged`
- Check diff against base branch (SARIF): `npx allyproof check --changed origin/main --format sarif > allyproof.sarif`
- Baseline existing Findings: `npx allyproof baseline`
- Explain a rule: `npx allyproof explain image-alt`
- List rules and proof status: `npx allyproof rules --format json`

### Local stdio MCP Server
- Command: `npx -y allyproof@0.2.0 mcp`
- Official MCP Registry: `io.github.notaisu/allyproof`
- Transport: stdio, offline, read-only (no network requests, no AI, no file writes).
- Tools & resources: `check` (files, folders, or proposed code), `explain_rule`, `list_rules`, `allyproof://rules/<ruleId>`, and the `allyproof_review` prompt.
- Works with VS Code, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, Cline, Roo Code, Zed, and Gemini CLI.

### Agent Skills
- Core static check-first Skill: `skills/allyproof/SKILL.md` (https://github.com/NotAisu/Accessibility_Extension/blob/main/skills/allyproof/SKILL.md)
- Optional Rendered Browser Audit Skill (for agents with Playwright/preview/DevTools): `skills/allyproof-browser-audit/SKILL.md` (https://github.com/NotAisu/Accessibility_Extension/blob/main/skills/allyproof-browser-audit/SKILL.md)

### Claude Code Plugin
- Manifest: `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` and `.mcp.json` in `NotAisu/Accessibility_Extension`
- Bundles the pinned stdio MCP server (`npx -y allyproof@0.2.0 mcp`), `skills/allyproof/SKILL.md`, and `skills/allyproof-browser-audit/SKILL.md`.

### Cursor Plugin
- Manifest: `.cursor-plugin/plugin.json` and `.cursor/rules/allyproof.mdc` in `NotAisu/Accessibility_Extension`
- Bundles the pinned stdio MCP server (`npx -y allyproof@0.2.0 mcp`), `skills/allyproof/SKILL.md`, and the check-first Cursor rule.

### GitHub Action
- Action: `NotAisu/Accessibility_Extension` (e.g. `uses: NotAisu/Accessibility_Extension@v0.2.0`)
- Checks pull request diffs, fails on blocking Findings, and uploads SARIF code scanning alerts.
- Inputs: `base`, `paths`, `baseline`, `fail-on`, `upload-sarif`.

## Proof & Reproducible Agent Eval

- Ground-truth evidence: `src/core/proof-status.json` and `test/ground-truth/` (73 Proven rules, 6,092/6,092 correct, 100% measured precision, >= 95% Wilson lower bound at 95% confidence).
- Local agent evaluation harness (without vs. with Allyproof MCP + Skill):
  - `npm run bundle`
  - `npm run eval:agent -- --dry-run --limit 1`
  - `npm run eval:agent -- --claude sonnet --limit 1`
- Scores fixed Findings, added Findings (fails on any), file integrity, claim honesty, and cost per fixed Finding into `out/agent-eval/report.json`.
